hello.text: Hello. I am your reading teacher. I will help you.

homeGoA.text: Tap the shining sound to go on.

homeGoB.text: Tap the next lesson to go on.

tapArrow.text: Tap the arrow to go on.

traceHelp.text: Follow the faint letter. Go slowly.

alienWord.text: This is an alien word. Sound it out.

madeUpWord.text: This is a made-up word. Sound it out.

trickyRegular.text: This word is not tricky. Sound it out.

selfRead.text: Read it out loud. Then tap to hear it.

notThatPart.text: That part sounds normal. Find the different part.

idleTap.text: Tap the letter. I will wait.

idlePick.text: Take your time. Tap the one you think.

idleSay.text: Say it out loud. Then tap the button.

idleTrace.text: Put your finger on the letter. Trace it.

idleArrow.text: Tap the arrow when you are ready.

idleHelp.text: Need help? Tap the speaker to hear me again.

idleWait.text: I will wait here. Tap when you are ready.

lockedNote.text: Not open yet. Finish the check first.

nameSoundNote.text: When we read, we use the sound, not the name.

qNote.text: The letter q is called cue. With u, it says

tipBedTrick.text: Make two fists with your thumbs up. Hold them side by side. The left fist is b. The right fist is d. Together they make bed.

tipB.text: b: the bat comes first, then the ball. The belly of b points right.

tipD.text: d: the drum comes first, then the stick. The belly of d points left.

tipP.text: p hangs down. Its loop is at the top, on the right.

tipQ.text: q hangs down too. It always needs its u.

masteryIntro.text: This is the check for the whole level. Do your best.

masteryPass.text: You passed! The next level is open.

masteryMiss.text: Not yet. Let's practise the parts that were hard, then try again.

teachIntro.text: Here is a new spelling for a sound. Tap it to hear it.

teachSuffix.text: This is an ending. Read the base word, then add the ending.

teachExample.text: Here it is in a word.

teachBlend.text: These letters keep both sounds. Say them quickly together.

ruleIntro.text: Here is a rule that helps you read.

attackIntro.text: A long word. Let's break it apart, step by step.

attackCount.text: Each vowel sound makes one chunk.

attackPeel.text: Tap the parts at the start or end that you know.

attackNoPeel.text: Nothing to take off here. Go on.

attackBlend.text: Tap each chunk to say it, then put them together.

attackFlex.text: Is it a real word? If not, try the vowel the other way.

attackCheckIntro.text: Show how you read a word you have never seen.

notVowel.text: Not a vowel sound. Try another.

ssPrime.text: Before you read, think about this.

ssWarm.text: Read each word out loud. Then tap it.

ssBuild.text: Build the word. Tap the parts in order.

ssRead.text: Read one part at a time. Tap a sentence to hear it.

ssFlu.text: Read it out loud. Tap start when you are ready.

ssThink.text: Think first. Then tap to see a good answer.

ssMark.text: How did you do? Tap one.

ssWrite.text: Write your answer. Then compare it.

ssTalk.text: Take each role. Say your answer out loud.

mouth_L1.02_A.text: Put your teeth together. Let the air hiss out.

mouth_L1.02_B.text: Open your mouth wide, like a big yawn.

mouth_L1.02_C.text: Tap your tongue behind your top teeth. Tap, tap.

mouth_L1.03_A.text: Pop your lips. Feel a little puff on your hand.

mouth_L1.03_B.text: Keep your mouth in a small smile.

mouth_L1.03_C.text: Touch your nose. Feel it buzz.

mouth_L1.04_A.text: Close your lips and hum. Feel the buzz.

mouth_L1.04_B.text: Touch your neck. Feel it buzz when you say d.

mouth_L1.05_A.text: Say g way back in your throat. Feel the buzz.

mouth_L1.05_B.text: Make your lips a little round, like a small circle.

mouth_L1.06_A.text: Say c way back in your mouth. No buzz this time.

mouth_L1.07_A.text: Say pit, then pet. Your mouth opens a bit more for e.

mouth_L1.07_B.text: Say cot, then cut. Hear the sound change.

mouth_L1.08_A.text: Curl your tongue back. It does not touch anything.

mouth_L1.08_B.text: Hold your hand by your mouth. Blow a little puff of air.

mouth_L1.09_A.text: Say pat, then bat. Feel the buzz on b.

mouth_L1.09_B.text: Put your top teeth on your bottom lip. Blow.

mouth_L1.09_C.text: Put your tongue up. Keep the sound going as long as you can.

mouth_L1.11_A.text: Say j. Feel a soft, buzzy pop in your mouth.

mouth_L1.11_B.text: Put your top teeth on your bottom lip. Feel the buzz.

mouth_L1.11_C.text: Make your lips round. Watch them in a mirror.

mouthLead.text: Here is how your mouth moves.
